title: Request Proposals Request
description: Ask a seller to create one or more indicative media-plan proposals from a brief. Provide exactly one brand source: either top-level brand or a natural-key account containing brand and operator. Each returned proposal_id identifies one immutable draft snapshot; revise or finalize it through refine_proposals, or decline it through decline_proposals.
x-tool-summary: Ask a seller to create one or more draft media-plan proposals from a campaign brief.

context_id.description: MCP compatibility field: servers ignore this value; A2A uses transport-native Message/Task contextId.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key required for retry-safe proposal creation.

account.description: Alternative brand source for proposal terms. Provide either this natural-key account containing brand and operator or top-level brand, not both.

brand.description: Alternative brand source for proposal terms. Provide either top-level brand or a natural-key account containing brand and operator, not both.

brief.description: Campaign goal, strategy, and requirements that are not represented in structured criteria.

opportunity.description: Optional planning-cycle context that the seller associates with every proposal created by this request. Experimental: a held opportunity_id updates it; a closed one is rejected.

include_collections.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). When true, asks the seller to return the response-level collections array: the full object for each collection the returned products' collections selectors reference. Sellers MUST NOT return collections unless this is true, and when it is true they SHOULD include every referenced collection. The 3.2 schema of this request rejects unknown fields, so a seller validating against it rejects the flag; send it only to a seller that lists media_buy.collection_cards in experimental_features. Buyers detect omitted collections by comparing product selectors with the returned array and resolve those from the publisher's adagents.json.

examples.brief: Five million adults 25-54 impressions in prime access and prime, :15 and :30 spots, measured by VideoAmp at C7.
